title: Filipino Catholics pray for Pope Leo's recovery after lung surgery
summary: Filipino Catholics on Wednesday (October 14) expressed sadness and offered prayers for Pope Leo's speedy recovery after doctors announced the 71-year-old pontiff had been diagnosed with lung cancer…

blocks.text: Filipino Catholics on Wednesday (October 14) expressed sadness and offered prayers for Pope Leo's speedy recovery after doctors announced the 71-year-old pontiff had been diagnosed with lung cancer and had part of one lung removed.
